title: AI Harness Context
description: Compact, session-persistent working memory for an AI coding assistant. Source of truth for orientation; read at session start, updated as work proceeds.

goal.description: One-sentence north star: what this project is for.

updated.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) this file was last updated.

current_focus.description: The single thing being worked on right now. First thing a new session should read.

tasks.description: Live to-do list. Prune completed items that no longer carry context.

notes.description: Optional terse detail or blocker reason.

decisions.description: Choices already made. Do not re-litigate these.

key_files.description: Map of where important things live, so the AI doesn't have to search.

role.description: What this file/dir is responsible for.

open_questions.description: Known unknowns waiting on the user or on investigation.

session_log.description: Recent history, newest first. Keep ~5-8 entries; summarize or drop older ones.

summary.description: One line: what changed this session.

next.description: Concrete next step for the following session.
